dos.text: Listen for the cancelable "promo:user-dismissed" event if you need to intercept dismissal, dismiss() only calls close()/remove() when the event isn't preventDefault()-ed.

donts.text: Don't expect imageAlignment="center" to get its own placement logic, render() only special-cases imageAlignment=="start" to put the image before the text; "center" and "end" are both placed after the text and rely on CSS alone for the visual difference.

Don't set imageAlignment, imageWidth, or imageDisplay expecting a visible effect without also setting imageSrc, imageTemplate() only renders when imageSrc is truthy, so those reflected attributes are inert without it.
